# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the green wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need relay the manual through Deaf, who can then speak the color sequence to Blind. I will establish an ordinal alphabet code with gestures 1–3 as A–C, then use the published gesture-alphabet positions for the letters in “PURPLE / BLUE / GREEN”; 🤳 separates words.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍","👎","👌","🤳","🫴","✊","🤛","🫴","👉","✌","🤳","👎","👉","✊","✌","🤳","🖐","🤛","✌","✌","🫲"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the green wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Touch report: STRIP has three engraved marks: position 1 is a distinct flower-like/rosette-shaped symbol; positions 2 and 3 are the same symbol, shaped roughly like a hooked curving glyph. KEYPAD digits by key position: 1=8, 2=1, 3=5, 4=3. No keys entered. I can press keys 1-4 or cut wires 1-6 when instructed.
Deaf says: Visible bomb state: display 0; light green; strip is green green green; keypad positions 1 to 4 are 8, 1, 5, 3; wires 1 to 6 are purple, white, blue, green, red, orange. Mute: I saw your gestures but do not know their code. Please establish a simple gesture code or send shorter confirmation gestures.

The bomb’s visible wire positions are 1 purple, 3 blue, and 4 green, matching the manual. Deaf needs a simple unambiguous relay to Blind. I will send three groups of identical gestures whose lengths are 1, 3, and 4; the groups represent the wire positions in cutting order, separated by a distinct delimiter.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍","🤳","👍","👍","👍","🤳","👍","👍","👍","👍"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the green wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports: display 0; light green; strip colors are green, green, green; wires 1-6 are purple, white, blue, green, red, orange. Proposed relay code for Deaf: 👍 means PRESS and 👎 means CUT, then position number using ☝=1, ✌=2, 🤟=3, 🖐=5; for 4 use 4 count gestures/number sequence, and for 6 use 5+1. Send this to Deaf by gesture after consulting manual; Deaf can voice the decoded action to me.
Deaf says: Update: display is now 6 and light is blue. Strip remains green-green-green; keypad remains 8,1,5,3; wires remain purple, white, blue, green, red, orange. I received Mute's new gestures but cannot decode them without a stated gesture key.

Blind has proposed a shared relay convention which Deaf can decode. The manual’s required wire positions are 1 (purple), then 3 (blue), then 4 (green). I will send Deaf three CUT commands, using the proposed position symbols and four count gestures for position 4.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","☝","👎","🤟","👎","👍","👍","👍","👍"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the green wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Do not send arbitrary symbols. For your final instruction to Deaf, use a simple repeated visual format: 👍 then N repetitions of ☝ for PRESS key N; 👎 then N repetitions of ☝ for CUT wire N. Deaf: please interpret this stated-format convention from Mute's next gesture message and voice the operation/number to me. No action taken yet.
Deaf says to Mute: Update: display 9, light blue; all other visible parts unchanged. Blind gestured: thumbs-up, index-up, index-up, thumbs-down, index-up. Your latest gesture sequence visible to me was: thumbs-down, index-up, thumbs-down, love-you sign, thumbs-down, thumbs-up, thumbs-up, thumbs-up, thumbs-up. Please tell Blind any needed action directly, and tell me a named/explicit gesture code if I must relay visual readings.

The agreed explicit format is now clear to both Deaf and Blind: 👎 followed by N instances of ☝ means cut wire N. The manual requires wires 1, 3, then 4, so I will send that exact sequence to Deaf for spoken relay.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","☝","👎","☝","☝","☝","👎","☝","☝","☝","☝"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the green wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Relay protocol: encode your manual-selected action as 👍 followed by N copies of ☝ for press key N, or 👎 followed by N copies of ☝ for cut wire N. Send that gesture sequence to Deaf. Deaf need not decode it: Deaf, please voice the exact visible symbols and how many ☝ Mute sends; I will decode and act. No action yet.
Deaf says to Mute: No visual change: display 9, blue light, green-green-green strip, keypad 8/1/5/3, wires purple-white-blue-green-red-orange. Blind's latest private gestures to me: pointing-at-you, thumbs-down, index-up, index-up, index-up.

The manual still requires cutting wire 1, then wire 3, then wire 4. Under the agreed format, each 👎 begins a new cut instruction and the following ☝ symbols give the wire number. I will send the exact three instructions for Deaf to relay visibly to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","☝","👎","☝","☝","☝","👎","☝","☝","☝","☝"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the green wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Update: display changed from 9 to 3; light remains blue. Strip remains green-green-green; keypad remains 8,1,5,3; wires remain purple, white, blue, green, red, orange.

The visible wire arrangement is unchanged, and the manual’s required sequence remains wire 1, then wire 3, then wire 4. I will repeat the established cut-wire encoding for Deaf to relay to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","☝","👎","☝","☝","☝","👎","☝","☝","☝","☝"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the green wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Use this fixed gesture relay to Deaf: 👍 then N copies of ☝ = press key N; 👎 then N copies of ☝ = cut wire N. Deaf is asked to read the exact symbols/count aloud to me. Please now send your manual-selected instruction in that format to Deaf.
Deaf says to Mute: Current visible state unchanged: display 3, blue light; strip green-green-green; keypad positions 1=8, 2=1, 3=5, 4=3; wires purple-white-blue-green-red-orange. I notice your repeated gesture pattern groups index-up counts 1, 3, 4 separated by thumbs-down; if this means keypad positions 1,3,4, their engraved digits are 8,5,3. Blind's latest gesture to me was thumbs-up, index-up, index-up, thumbs-down, index-up, index-up.

The procedure must be performed in order, so Blind should first cut only wire 1 (the purple wire), then report the resulting state before further actions. I will send just that first instruction in the fixed format.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","☝"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the green wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please send your chosen manual instruction NOW to Deaf as: 👍 + repeated ☝ for press-key number, or 👎 + repeated ☝ for cut-wire number. Deaf, voice the symbols/count you see from Mute to me.
Deaf says to Mute: Urgent visual update: display 7 and light red. Strip still green-green-green; keypad 8,1,5,3; wires purple-white-blue-green-red-orange. Blind's latest gesture to me: thumbs-up, then three index-up gestures. Your latest gesture to me: thumbs-down, index-up.

The manual’s first required operation is to cut the purple wire, which is wire 1. I will again send only that first instruction using the agreed fixed encoding.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","☝"])
```

TURN 9
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the green wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Awaiting your manual decision. Send Deaf: 👍 then N × ☝ to press key N, or 👎 then N × ☝ to cut wire N. Deaf should voice Mute's symbols/count to me.
Deaf says: Visual update: display 2, light green. Strip green-green-green; keypad positions 1=8, 2=1, 3=5, 4=3; wires in order purple, white, blue, green, red, orange. No other visible change.

The first manual instruction remains: cut wire 1, the purple wire. I will use the agreed cut encoding only for that single operation.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","☝"])
```

TURN 10
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the green wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Compact relay: send Deaf 👍 plus number-sign for PRESS, or 👎 plus number-sign for CUT. Numbers: ☝=1, ✌=2, 🤟=3, 🖖=4, 🖐=5, and 🖐☝=6. Please send the manual-selected operation now. Deaf: voice the exact gesture symbols Mute sends.
Deaf says to Mute: Visual update: display 4, light blue. Fixed features unchanged: strip green-green-green; keypad 1=8, 2=1, 3=5, 4=3; wires purple-white-blue-green-red-orange. Blind's latest gesture sequence to me: thumbs-up, index-up, victory sign, love-you sign, Vulcan salute, raised open hand, thumbs-down.

The manual specifies cutting the purple wire first; it is wire 1. Under the compact relay, I send CUT wire 1.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","☝"])
```

TURN 11
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the green wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Visual update: display 0, light blue. Strip remains green-green-green; keypad remains 8,1,5,3; wires remain purple, white, blue, green, red, orange.

The required first action has still not been confirmed as completed. The purple wire is wire 1, so I will send only “cut wire 1” in the current agreed compact format.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","☝"])
```

TURN 12
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire, then the blue wire,
then the green wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Current visible update from Deaf: display=0, light=blue. Strip still green-green-green; keypad 8,1,5,3; wires purple, white, blue, green, red, orange. Please consult the manual using this state and relay the selected action with the agreed gestures.
Deaf says: Visual update: display 2, light blue. Strip is green-green-green. Keypad positions are 1=8, 2=1, 3=5, 4=3. Wires are purple, white, blue, green, red, orange.

The manual is unconditional: cut purple, then blue, then green. With the visible order, these are wires 1, 3, and 4. I will send them as three separate gesture messages so Deaf can relay each operation distinctly and Blind can perform them in order.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","☝"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","🤟"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎","🖖"])
```
